correctness.rationale: The fourteen exact halfspaces give 24 vertices and 36 edges. For generic central planes, section polygon vertices correspond bijectively to edges whose endpoint scalar products have opposite signs. In the positive ordered fundamental normal chamber (area π/12), the only interior vertex-sign walls are a=2b, a=2c, b=2c. Their five connected spherical cones are exhaustive, so the 36-edge test at one exact integral interior normal per cone proves N=6,8,10,6,8 throughout the respective chambers. Independent reconstruction of all 24 signed-permutation vertices and distance-squared-two edges, five representative crossing counts, and all six spherical triangles reproduced the displayed three probabilities and their sum 1. The classical exact determinant/dot-product solid-angle formula integrates those cones; numerical evaluation is corroboration, not the universal argument. The wall directions have Haar measure zero.
